title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai – Ritwik Bhowmik, Ayesha Raza Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for Meethe Mein Kya Hai – Ritwik Bhowmik, Ayesha Raza — premieres Oct 30, 2026.
body:
• The trailer for Meethe Mein Kya Hai – Ritwik Bhowmik, Ayesha Raza dropped October 21, 2026.
  • New movie premiering Oct 30, 2026 on Netflix India.
  • This khatti meethi family is coming to meet yours

The makers of Meethe Mein Kya Hai – Ritwik Bhowmik, Ayesha Raza have released the official trailer, unveiled October 21, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to streaming.
